items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: I have the Marit's picture somewhere, but I don't know where. In a uniform that he played.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. And look at this. This is about, that's about 45 years ago. That's Papa, that's Georgie, that, you know little Charlie Cadillus that played Clown in there? Oh, yeah. That's him. And that's my son. Yeah, you see, that's them. And that's Babe Brigger. I don't know this fella. I believe he played the piano, I think, this fella. They played, do you remember when the war in 17 in Alexandre Louisier? 1917? Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. That's when that was. When they played, in Alexandria, Louisiana, yeah. Mm-hmm. I have the…
She picks up all that stuff and keeps it. That's nice that she does. He'll be glad she did. Yeah.
